target.title: feat(models): add Claude Sonnet 5 support
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5 as `claude-sonnet-5`, but OpenClaw lacked its catalog metadata, thinking contract, provider routes, pricing transition, aliases, and transport restrictions. Users could not select the model consistently across Anthropic, Vertex, Bedrock, Mantle, and Claude CLI.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Add the exact Sonnet 5 contract: 1M context, 128k output, image input, adaptive thinking, native effort levels, and the August 31, 2026 promotional pricing transition.
- Normalize the model across direct Anthropic, Claude CLI, Vertex global/US/EU endpoints, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock Mantle.
- Enforce provider-specific request behavior: direct Anthropic supports explicit thinking off; Bedrock and Mantle remain adaptive; unsupported sampling, service-tier, and assistant-prefill fields are omitted.
- Advance generic Sonnet aliases without overwriting explicit user configuration or removing Sonnet 4.6.
- Align docs, generated baselines, plugin SDK exports, and focused regression tests. Release notes remain maintainer-owned per the repository landing gate.

## User Impact

Users can select `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5` and supported cloud equivalents with correct context/output limits, adaptive-thinking behavior, and pricing. Existing explicit Sonnet 4.6 configurations continue to work. Claude CLI subscription models retain zero API cost accounting.

## Evidence

- Official Anthropic model contract: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/whats-new-sonnet-5
- Official Anthropic pricing: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing
- Official AWS Bedrock model card and pricing: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-anthropic-claude-sonnet-5.html and https://aws.amazon.com/bedrock/pricing/
- Official Google Vertex model and pricing docs: https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/models/partner-models/claude/sonnet-5 and https://cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/generative-ai/pricing
- Final structured autoreview: clean; no accepted/actionable findings.
- Exact-head secretless CI at `b2266d5e3fb094bf9ae6b06a66f0afe0ba9a4801`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28819425388
- Sanitized AWS run `run_219e96cee242` exercised 251 focused tests and exposed three final contract defects; those defects were fixed before the exact-head CI run above. Replacement AWS acquisition then failed twice at the broker, so final untrusted-source proof followed the policy fallback to secretless fork CI.
- No credentialed provider call was run pre-merge: the contributor branch is untrusted, no Anthropic or Bedrock bearer credential was exported, and credential hydration is forbidden for this lane.
